```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth) #for basemaps
library(ggsci) #for color palettes
library(leaflet) #for interactive maps
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
fish <- read_csv("combinedFish.csv")
invert <- read_csv("combinedInvert.csv")

fish <- fish |>
  dplyr::select(latitude, longitude, location)

invert <- invert |>
  dplyr::select(latitude, longitude, location)

both <- rbind(fish, invert)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
unique <- both |>
  dplyr::select(latitude, longitude, location) |>
  distinct()
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
unique_tas <- unique |>
  filter(location %in% c("Bicheno", "D'Entrecasteaux & Derwent", "Maria Island", "Kent Group", "Flinders Island", "Port Davey", "Ninepin Point", "Rocky Cape", "Tasmania - North", "Tasmania - North East", "Tasmania - South East", "Tasmania - South", "Tasmania - West", "Tinderbox", "Swansea"))

unique_vic <- unique |>
  filter(location %in% c("Beware Reef", "Bunurong", "Cape Howe", "Gippsland Lakes", "Point Hicks", "Point Addis", "Port Phillip Bay", "Port Phillip Heads", "Victoria - Eastern", "Victoria - North east", "Victoria - western", "Wilsons Promontory"))
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
unique_tas <- unique_tas |>
  mutate(location = case_when(
    location == "Rocky Cape" ~ "Tasmania - North",
    location == "Swansea" ~ "Tasmania - North East",
    location == "Bicheno" ~ "Tasmania - North East",
    location == "Ninepin Point" ~ "D'Entrecasteaux & Derwent",
    location == "Tinderbox" ~ "D'Entrecasteaux & Derwent",
    TRUE ~ location  # keeps all other location names as they are
  ))

unique_vic <- unique_vic |>
  mutate(location = case_when(
    location == "Victoria - North east" ~ "Cape Howe",
    location == "Beware Reef" ~ "Victoria - Eastern",
    location == "Point Hicks" ~ "Victoria - Eastern",
    TRUE ~ location  # keeps all other location names as they are
  ))
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
# convert to sf
locations_sf <- st_as_sf(unique_tas, 
                          coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), 
                          crs = 4326)

# get a basemap
australia <- ne_states(country = "australia", returnclass = "sf")

# plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = australia) +
  geom_sf(data = locations_sf, aes(color = location), size = 2) +
  #geom_sf_text(data = locations_sf, aes(label = location), 
   #            size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(144, 149), ylim = c(-44, -40)) +
  scale_color_d3() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Survey locations by name",
       color = "Location")
```

### Tasmanian Locations

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# extract d3 colours
d3_colours <- pal_d3()(length(unique(unique_tas$location)))

# use in leaflet
pal <- colorFactor(palette = d3_colours, domain = unique_tas$location)

leaflet(unique_tas, width = "100%") |>
  addTiles() |>  # adds OpenStreetMap basemap
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    color = ~pal(location),
    label = ~paste(location, latitude, longitude, sep = " | "),  # shows location name on hover
    radius = 5,
    fillOpacity = 1
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~location,
    title = "Location"
  )
```

#### Questions
1. There are a few points labeled Tasmania - North East by Freycinet; is this too south to be labeled North East? Should they have a different location name?
2. Some of the Maria Island points are on the island and some are on the mainland across from the island. Should both be labeled Maria Island?
3. D'Entrecasteaux & Derwent is very close spatially to Tasmania - South East. Should these be combined?
4. There are a few points in the wrong spot, like the Tasmania - North East point on the West coast. I don't know if the lat/lon or the location name were entered incorrectly, so what is the best way to address that?
5. There are some Tasmania - West points by Macquarie Harbour, should they have a different name?


### Victorian Locations

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# extract d3 colours
d3_colours <- pal_d3()(length(unique(unique_vic$location)))

# use in leaflet
pal <- colorFactor(palette = d3_colours, domain = unique_vic$location)

leaflet(unique_vic, width = "100%") |>
  addTiles() |>  # adds OpenStreetMap basemap
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    color = ~pal(location),
    label = ~paste(location, latitude, longitude, sep = " | "),  # shows location name on hover
    radius = 5,
    fillOpacity = 1
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~location,
    title = "Location"
  )
```

#### Questions
1. I kept the Gippsland Lakes as separate points from Victoria - Eastern because they appear to be more sheltered. Should they be grouped with Victoria - Eastern instead?
2. Should Cape Howe be included in Victoria - Eastern as well?
3. It looks like there's only one Victoria - western point. Is this worth keeping?
4. Should we keep Point Addis separate from Port Phillip Heads?
5. There are some Port Phillip Bay points that are very close to points from Port Phillip Heads. Do any of those points need to be fixed?
